review: 702.144a-1: base expected called the original spell a copy ('three copies'); reworded to the original plus two copies.

scenarios.title: Demonstrate copies the spell for its caster and for an opponent
decisions: A casts Excavation Technique targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping four Plains.

The demonstrate trigger goes on the stack and resolves: A chooses to copy the spell and chooses Hill Giant as the new target of A's copy; A chooses B as the opponent, and B copies the spell and chooses Savannah Lions as the new target of B's copy.
Both players pass until the stack is empty (B's copy resolves first, then A's copy, then the original).

variants.label: copy
variants.expected: The original and two copies are on the stack: A's copy and B's copy. Savannah Lions, Hill Giant and Grizzly Bears are each destroyed. A creates 2 Treasure tokens (for Savannah Lions) and B creates 4 Treasure tokens. Excavation Technique goes to A's graveyard; the copies cease to exist.

variants.label: decline
variants.delta: A chooses not to copy the spell when the demonstrate trigger resolves.
variants.expected: No copies are created. Only Grizzly Bears is destroyed. B creates 2 Treasure tokens, A creates none. Hill Giant and Savannah Lions stay on the battlefield.
